## Governance

## Checklist

- [ ] Branch name follows `<type>/<ticket-id>-<description>`
- [ ] Commit messages follow `<type>(<ticket-id>): <description>` and use this branch's ticket ID

- [ ] This change is ready to merge (no WIP commits, no debug code)
